title: Self-Describing Bundle Format
description: A bundle format where the first bytes describe everything inside: manifest, versions, and hashes. Self-description means any tool can inspect a bundle without knowing its origin. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Self-Describing Bundle Format
demo.program:
# Universal deliverable packaging: Self-Describing Bundle Format
import hashlib, json
package = {"format": "JAH-BUNDLE-1", "contents": "payload;manifest;signatures".split(";"), "title": "Self-Describing Bundle Format"}
manifest = json.dumps(package, sort_keys=True)
package["integrity"] = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(manifest.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
print(json.dumps(package, indent=2))
print("OK - deliverable packaged with integrity hash")
